'''S'oelle Khiss''' was the nephew of [[Secles Uslopos]], [[Abdi-Badawzi]]'s chancellor. Khiss often fulfilled his uncle's role in Badawzi's court when Uslopos was conducting business on the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord's]] behalf. In the event of Uslopos' death, Khiss was slated to replace him.<ref name="BSS" />

Khiss was a supporter of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and yearned to serve under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]]. He met his hero on one occasion, voicing support for the Rebel cause. Badawzi assigned Khiss to keep contacts open between his crime network, the Alliance, and the [[Black Bha'lir]].<ref name="BSS" />
